notes.title: eXplosive Dinosaurs big update is finally here! 😁🎉🐱‍🐉
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33034891/f2a22018dc18f2f083f2d01492d2be93de2fc210.jpg

This is Pablo Navarro, director of eXplosive Dinosaurs. 🦖💣

It's been a long time since our last post.

Our idea was to have this update published in march, but we had a lot of fixes we wanted to implement and test, and it took a lot longer than what we expected.

Just open the game again and enjoy!

Change list: 👷‍♂️
- 4 new minigames, adds up to 40!
- Added a gauge to show the difficulty in each minigame.
- Added renderer option to have more than 60fps.
- Improved performance.
- Improved help section.
- Improved 2V2 team mode (Try it! It's the best!)
- Balanced difficulty on some minigames.
- Size of the game files hugely optimized (from 600MB to 200MB, and you won't notice any quality loss!)
- Lots of bug fixes.

And that's it. We hope you enjoy those changes! 🥰

Cheers.
Pablo Navarro

notes.title: About the spring update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We said that the update would be ready in march, but we're making many improvements over the last release, not just adding 4 minigames that we had planned. We're also improving the minigames that are already in the minigame pool, taking into account all of our players' feedback in events, Twitter and Steam.

So, when will the update be ready? 
We don't know for sure, but we hope to release it before summer (so it still can be called spring update ːsteamhappyː)

Thank you for your attention & interest!

Pablo Navarro
Director & Main programmer of RAWR Lab
